findings.claim: head_sha() resolves HEAD's symref target from commondir only. A worktree HEAD that symref'd a per-worktree-namespaced ref (refs/bisect/*, refs/worktree/*, refs/rewritten/*) would miss the per-worktree copy and return ''. UNREACHABLE in practice: git detaches HEAD (raw sha) during bisect/rebase, so head_sha returns the raw sha via the non-'ref: ' branch and never enters ref resolution. Strictly better than the pre-fix code, which returned '' for ALL refs in a worktree. Not unit-tested because git cannot produce the precondition without first detaching HEAD.
